intro.text:
TERRAN ASCENDANCY MANDATE - Exoplanetary Forces. Neural Training Facility, Bay 3.

You are a recruit. Before any landing or boarding, the Mandate teaches your nerves what a unit sees: situation awareness, close-quarters tactics, how to stay alive in a corridor.

An instructor bot seats you in a rugged simulator pod and checks the straps twice. As you lock your helmet to the connector, you notice the staff - too many of them, moving too fast. Half the pods in your row are dark. Two have their panels off; one is held shut with tape and a cable tie.

Your simconnector buzzes. The first battle simulatron begins.

SCENARIO: a facility built round one machine, meant to run as root forever. Something answered from below the hardware, and the machine's daemons became something else. Every human account was revoked at once. Yours too.

You are rootless. Every door checks permissions you no longer have.

e1_end.text:
The exit switch takes your weight and the lift drops into the dark.

Somewhere below, a clock is ticking that was not ticking before. Cron got away. It does not chase, it schedules - and it has put you on its list.

For a moment the sim thins out: the inside of the pod's lid, a red light, someone shouting a number that might be yours. Then the dark comes back.

The lift stops with a bang at a loading dock. Containers to the roof, and something big and yellow parked in a bay.

outro_demo.text: SIMULATION PAUSED. End of the demo - Episode 1 goes on in the full game.

outro_lose.text:
SIMULATION FAILED. Process terminated.

The pod hisses and the lid stays shut. "Again," says the instructor bot. Read the tells, use the barrels, step off the marked floor.

e1m9_intro.text:
Behind the goggles' closet, a switch nobody labelled. You throw it anyway. The floor drops: a service lift, old and loud, going down past the boot bay into the swap partition.

This part of the simulatron was not in the briefing.

e1m9_end.text:
The last page is swapped back in. Somewhere above, Cron's schedule skips a beat - it knows a process got out of its queue.

The instructor bot cuts in, too loud and too late: "Recruit, that sector is not part of your training. Do not disconnect." A lift takes you up through the dark, and lets you out at a loading dock.

e1m2_end.text:
The control room's switch drops the dock's gantry. Every container in that bay held a library something needs; the loader links each one to where it runs. You have just been linked too - into whatever runs beneath the hardware.

The instructor bot's voice comes through broken: "...pod six... pod six is not answering..." Your pod is six.
